title: selaginella helvetica
intro: Selaginella helvetica, commonly known as Swiss club moss, is a type of evergreen, perennial plant belonging to the family Selaginellaceae. It has been traditionally used in medicine due to its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties that may help to reduce stress, improve respiratory issues, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella helvetica are attributed to its ability to modulate the body's response to stress, promote relaxation, and exhibit adaptogenic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
